Mark: OK / change (write the correction) / remove.

| AS23-006 | In early gestation the thermal and mechanical indices should be kept at or below 1.0 and Doppler modalities used sparingly. | ASE-2023-FETALECHO: Table 8 (early gestation), p. 695-696 | ai-cross-checked | |

| AS23-011 | Power Doppler displays the amplitude of the Doppler signal rather than the frequency shift; it helps to show small vessels, low-velocity flow such as in veins, and septal defects.
